Internal consistency (Cronbach’s alpha,: A meta-analysis showed that nine studies contained Cronbach's alpha coefficients greater than or equal to 0.70.
Inter-rater reliability: The PSQI is a relatively new assessment. Not enough research has been conducted on inter-rater reliability to give a comprehensive rating.
Test-retest reliability: Two of the studies reported the intraclass correlation coefficient of greater than or equal to 0.70 over a period of several weeks.
Test-repeatability: Like inter-rater reliability, limited research is available on test-repeatability.
